items.title: Kushner seeks to revive Gaza peace as Netanyahu resists Hamas disarmament
items.description: US envoy Jared Kushner meets Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday after talks with Hamas in Egypt, seeking to revive the second phase of a Gaza peace plan stalled over Israel’s demand for the group’s complete disarmament.
items.titleIt: Kushner seeks to revive Gaza peace as Netanyahu resists Hamas disarmament

items.title: 'Emergency' ship rescues migrant boat, 7 dead
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 17 - Emergency's Life Support rescue ship rescued a boat with about fifty migrants on board Monday morning in international waters in the Libyan SAR zone. Seven migrants died during the crossing, and two are in serious condition due to suffocation, the NGO reports. "The shipwrecked people," Emergency explains, "reported they departed at dawn on August 16 from Zuwara, and are originally from Somalia and Egypt. items.title: Somalia: Somali President Tells AU Peacekeepers to Leave
items.description: [Nile Post] Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has said his country is now capable of taking full responsibility for its security, calling for African Union peacekeepers to leave Somalia after nearly two decades of fighting Al-Shabaab militants.

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: Kenya: Koome Disowns Fake Letter Alleging Plot to Influence Supreme Court
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Judiciary has disowned a letter circulating on social media and purportedly signed by Chief Justice Martha Koome, dismissing it as fabricated and warning the public against using it to advance political narratives.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Koome Disowns Fake Letter Alleging Plot to Influence Supreme Court

items.title: Kenya: Gachagua Claims 12mn Votes As He Stakes Claim to Opposition Flagbearer Role
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua has claimed to command the support of nearly 12 million Kenyans as he positions himself for the 2027 presidential race.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Gachagua Claims 12mn Votes As He Stakes Claim to Opposition Flagbearer Role

items.title: Worries grow over mysterious illness killing Kenyan elephants
items.description: Worries over the death of elephants are mounting in southern Kenya, where at least 19 animals have died since June from an unexplained condition.
